hub.title: Free job search tools

resumeCheck.body: Upload your resume. See what to fix first, why it matters and how to fix it.

campus.title: Campus recruiting calendar
campus.body: Application dates for graduate programmes, taken from each company's official page.

jobAlerts.title: Job alerts by email
jobAlerts.body: Get new jobs that match one search by email, daily or weekly. No account needed.

hub.honesty: These checks are automated. They show what your resume says. They do not predict whether you will hear back.

upload.label: Your resume
upload.hint: PDF, Word or plain text, up to {mb} MB.

tools.privacy: We don't keep your file. The report and the text we read from it are deleted after {hours} hours, unless you create an account and keep them. Only this browser can open the result.

consent.label: I agree that %BRAND% reads this resume with automated software to make this report. It is deleted after {hours} hours unless I create an account.
consent.readingService: The file may be sent to {service}, the resume-reading service %BRAND% uses, on servers in mainland China.
consent.offshore: During the beta, this is processed outside mainland China, in the United States.
consent.whereUnknown: Who reads it and where it is processed is set out in the privacy notice.

allowance.left: {count, plural, =0 {No free checks left today} one {# free check left today} other {# free checks left today}}
allowance.limit: Up to {limit} free checks a day

check.title: Resume check
check.sub: Upload your resume. We check it against a checklist and show what to fix first.
check.running: Reading your resume. This can take up to a minute.

match.title: Resume and job check
match.sub: Paste a job description and see which of its requirements your resume shows.
match.postingTitleHint: As it appears in the posting.
match.postingTextHint: Paste the full text of the posting (at least {min} characters).
match.linkNotice: This looks like a link. The free tool does not open links: paste the text of the job description instead. With an account you can add a job by its link.
match.running: Comparing your resume with the job description. This can take up to a minute.

report.automatedNote: Checked by software against {rules} rules. Not reviewed by a person, and not a prediction of whether you will hear back.
report.automatedNoteNoCount: Checked by software. Not reviewed by a person, and not a prediction of whether you will hear back.
report.noIssues: Nothing to fix on this checklist.
report.more: {count, plural, one {# more issue is} other {# more issues are}} in the full report.
report.cached: You checked this file earlier today, so this did not use a free check.

matchReport.title: Your resume and “{title}”
matchReport.noScore: This compares requirements and words. It is not a fit score, and not your chance of getting hired.
matchReport.titlePass: Your resume shows this title or a close one.
matchReport.titleWarn: Your resume shows a related title.
matchReport.titleFail: Your resume does not show this title. If you have done this work, name it in a heading or the summary.
matchReport.yearsDetail: Asks for {required}+ years. Your dated experience adds up to about {found}.
matchReport.yearsNotListed: The posting does not list a number of years.
matchReport.yearsNoDates: No dated experience found in your resume.
matchReport.eduNotListed: The posting does not list an education level.
matchReport.eduNotFound: No degree found in your resume.
matchReport.eduMet: Your degree meets the listed level.
matchReport.eduBelow: Your degree is below the listed level.
matchReport.honest: Only add a missing word if it is true for you.

signup.titleCheck: See the full report and fix it
signup.bodyCheck: Create a free account to see every issue, keep this resume and fix it in the editor.
signup.titleMatch: Tailor this resume to the job
signup.bodyMatch: Create a free account to keep this resume, tailor it to this job and see a fit score with the reasons behind it.

claim.title: Keep this resume in your account
claim.body: Add the resume you checked to your resumes and see the full report.
claim.done: Saved. It is in your resumes now.
claim.limit: Your account already holds the most resumes it can. Delete one, then try again.
claim.gone: This result is no longer available. Results are kept for 24 hours, in the browser that ran the check. Run the check again.
claim.error: We could not save it. Try again.
claim.alreadySaved: This resume is already saved in an account.

errors.file_unreadable: We could not read text from this file. If it is a scan or a photo, try a PDF saved from a word processor.
errors.file_too_large: This file is larger than {mb} MB.
errors.file_wrong_type: Use a PDF, Word or plain-text file.
errors.consent_required: Tick the box to let %BRAND% read this resume.
errors.posting_too_short: Paste the full job description (at least {min} characters).
errors.posting_too_long: This job description is too long. Paste the main part.
errors.rate_limited: You have used today's {limit} free checks with this tool. Try again tomorrow, or create a free account to keep going.
errors.result_expired: This result was deleted after 24 hours. Run the check again.
errors.network: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rate_limited_unknown: You have used today's free checks with this tool. Try again tomorrow, or create a free account to keep going.
errors.result_missing: We could not open this result. A result opens only in the browser that ran the check, for 24 hours. Run the check again.
errors.run_in_progress: A check is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries today. Try again tomorrow.

tools.unavailable: The free resume checks are not available here yet.
